context:
Goal: the team works from the newest shared settings.
Problem (rule): the cloud refresh hook says it could not reach the newest settings commit, so the coordinator runs on an older one, and only your word says whether to adopt a commit whose changes nobody has read.
Based on (read): the refresh hook output at 20:32 CST on 2026-11-18: "reinstall did not reach d19ac53 (record at c4347c9)".
Departs from: the coordinator session runs claude-settings at c4347c932 — option a moves it to d19ac53 after the changelog is read.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; the coordinator keeps working on c4347c932 and acts on your answer next.
home: claude-settings, the cloud refresh hook (the hook that reinstalls the shared settings at session start)

options.gain: The coordinator and its lanes run on the newest shared settings, with the changelog read first so no rule changes unseen.
options.how: Re-run the cloud refresh hook now. Read the changelog of d19ac53 before any lane starts.
options.label: Re-run the refresh and read the changelog first
options.lose: Lanes wait for the changelog read, and the new commit may change rules the team already works to.

options.gain: No rule changes under running lanes.
options.how: The coordinator stays on c4347c932 until you say to move.
options.label: Stay on c4347c932 until you say
options.lose: The team keeps running on settings that are not the newest, and the hook's warning stays.

ref: claude-settings commit d19ac53 (the newest shared settings, changes unread); claude-settings commit c4347c9 (the settings this coordinator runs on)

shown.label: Re-run the refresh and read the changelog first
Stay on c4347c932 until you say

title: The coordinator runs on older shared settings than the newest. Re-run the refresh, or stay put?
why: The newest commit may carry rule changes nobody has read, so reading the changelog before lanes start costs little.
